# Reading the three segments around the marker cycle KR -> JP -> CN:
#   SHP + AIN + TBRU  =  SHPAINTBRU
# The cycle has no fixed start ("回环的注脚"); rotating two places gives
#   PAINTBRUSH
# and 「来自东方的三支笔」 lands on it exactly.
# The three footers name the three works, each in the PREVIOUS language's script:
#   Korean panel footer  (pinyin) wu kan tu   = 烏瞰圖  -> the Korean work
#   Japanese panel footer (hangul) 봄과 아수라  = 春と修羅 -> the Japanese work
